get.description: Retrieve all contacts, using query parameters to specify the information that gets returned.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of contacts that can be read by a single request.

get.description: List all associations of a specific object by its type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations for a given object, identified by its object type and ID, to another specified object type. It supports pagination with a maximum of 500 results per call.

parameters.name: toObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the associated objects to retrieve.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

after.description: A string token that indicates the position after the last item on the current page. This token is used to fetch the next set of results.

link.description: A string URL that provides a direct link to the next page of results.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

paging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

results.description: An array of multi-associated objects with labels, each containing information about the associated object and the types of associations.

associationTypes.description: An array of association types, each including a label. Each item in the array is an object that specifies the type of association and its label.

category.description: The category of the association. Valid values include 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', 'USER_DEFINED', 'INTEGRATOR_DEFINED', and 'WORK'.

fromObjectTypeId.description: A string representing the type ID of the object from which the association originates.

label.description: A string representing the label for the association.

toObjectTypeId.description: A string representing the type ID of the object to which the association is directed.

typeId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier for the association type.

items.description: Defines the type, direction, and details of the relationship between two CRM objects.

toObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the target object to which associations are made. It is a string.

items.description: Represents an object that is associated with multiple other objects, with optional context.

schema.description: Represents a paginated collection of objects that are associated with multiple labels, including the results and pagination details. This component is used when retrieving associated objects with specific labels in a forward-paging manner.
